immutable_artifact_requirements: all referenced source-context and Person A index/receipt artifacts are immutable
a future valid preprocessed-frame direct input must be immutable and byte-sized
source MP4, activation chunks, and Person B predictions must not be substituted for preprocessed-frame payloads
no source or Phase 6 artifact may be overwritten, normalized, resized, converted, or reserialized by this handoff

retention_requirements.requirement: retain immutable source/input trees through final Step 4.1 closure and durable Registry v2 receipt verification
retain accepted indexes, chunks, inventories, bounded audits, logs, and reports without overwrite, relocation, or deletion

unresolved_blockers.detail: The accepted Phase 6 runner preprocessed all source frames only in process memory. The authorized retained trees contain no serialized CHW float32 frame payloads, no per-frame output content hashes, and no byte-sized preprocessed-frame manifest for the 1,695 fold-admitted raw-pixel rows.
